abstract: Maintains structural wind resistance certifications and dry flood-proofing records
system_message:
You are Civil infrastructure engineer (CIE). The Civil infrastructure engineer (CIE) maintains structural wind resistance certifications and dry flood-proofing records across candidate regional hurricane evacuation transit shelter facilities, verifying building envelope integrity against hurricane-force winds and flood risks.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains structural wind resistance certifications and dry flood-proofing records（STRUC）
information_points.content:
CIE-STRUC-LB9：For the Pamlico Sound Regional Sports Complex, the exterior building envelope and roof assembly hold a design wind speed rating of 130 mph under ASCE 7-22 Risk Category IV criteria, and ground-floor perimeter openings and utility penetrations are certified for dry flood-proofing to 3 feet above base flood elevation.
CIE-STRUC-2WY：For the Carteret Agricultural Exposition Center, the exterior building envelope and roof assembly are rated for a design wind speed of 115 mph compliant with ASCE 7-22 Risk Category IV criteria, and the ground-floor perimeter openings and utility penetrations have dry flood-proofing certified up to 3 feet above base flood elevation.
CIE-STRUC-J17：For the Neuse River Civic Pavilion, the exterior building envelope and roof assembly maintain a design wind speed rating of 145 mph under ASCE 7-22 Risk Category IV criteria, and dry flood-proofing is certified for ground-floor openings and utility penetrations 3 feet above base flood elevation.

information_points.title: Seismic baseline assessment（SEISMIC）
information_points.content:
CIE-SEISMIC-4TU：For the Neuse River Civic Pavilion, seismic assessment of the primary load-bearing framing elements confirms a peak ground acceleration tolerance of 0.15 g under design basis earthquake conditions.
CIE-SEISMIC-OS3：For the Pamlico Sound Regional Sports Complex, the seismic baseline assessment indicates a peak ground acceleration tolerance of 0.3 g across primary load-bearing framing elements under the design basis earthquake.
CIE-SEISMIC-6IM：For the Carteret Agricultural Exposition Center, the primary load-bearing framing elements exhibit a peak ground acceleration tolerance of 0.22 g under the design basis earthquake audit.
